verdict.rationale: Tavily is a SaaS web-search API that handles user queries, so a training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack never documents a no-training policy or an opt-out control. The only privacy-related item describes validation layers that block PII leakage, which is an adjacent control and not a guarantee against training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
